evidence: Implements core BIP352 cryptographic primitives, address encoding, and scanning interfaces in common/bip352.{h,cpp} wrapping libsecp256k1.
rationale: Implements core BIP352 cryptographic and transaction processing logic as shared utilities, serving as the foundational building block for Silent Payments. Placed in common to unblock downstream wallet send/receive functionality, address parsing, and node-level indexing for light clients (#28536).
